newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips finish weaker despite Dow jump.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips finish weaker despite Dow jump.

text.p: Kuala Lumpur blue chips ignored Wall Street's record-setting surge, closing weaker on Tuesday as poor local sentiment continued to dominate trading. The Composite Index ended down 4.97 points to 1090.00.

"There's no change," said an equity salesman at W.I. Carr in Hong Kong. He said investors remained worried about commercial banking and property sectors following stricter loan measures by the central bank for property and stock purchases.
"People are convinced these sectors are not going to do well," he said, adding that the bearish mood also stifled buying in other industries.
